sources.quote: Each lot, before release to production
Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.

findings.why: Heat H-4471 is proposed for release to production. The documents contain no EN 10204 3.1 certificate and no tensile result for this heat. Rev C and the control plan require both: grade EN AW-6082-T6 and Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). Alluminio B is approved for BR-220 at TO1 for STL (AP-0311), but that approval does not replace the per-lot certificate. A person must supply the certificate and test result.
